macros.name: arrow
macros.doc: An ARROW is specified by the \arrow command, which may also be used anywhere in math mode, independent of the diagram environment.

macros.name: arrow
macros.doc: An ARROW is specified by the \arrow command, which may also be used anywhere in math mode, independent of the diagram environment.

macros.name: dgARROWLENGTH
macros.doc: The most important parameter is \dgARROWLENGTH, which specifies the minimum length for all arrows.

macros.name: dgARROWPARTS
macros.doc: An arrow is divided into \dgARROWPARTS parts for custom positioning of labels along the arrow (the only sensible choices for this number are 2,4,6,8,10).

macros.name: dgHORIZPAD
macros.doc: The padding increases the apparent horizontal size of each formula by \dgHORIZPAD and the apparent vertical size by \dgVERTPAD.

macros.name: dgLABELOFFSET
macros.doc: \dgLABELOFFSET is the (approximate) distance which will separate labels from their arrows.

envs.name: diagram
envs.doc: The diagram environment allows the LaTeX 2ε user to easily create complex commutative diagrams, by placing formula nodes on a conceptual grid and attaching arrows to them.
